purpose: Qualify the live BIEN 4.2 database identity, agg_traits schema, and trait-name vocabulary before any generalized trait value is selected or returned.

source_contract.official_primary_citation: Enquist et al. 2026, Methods in Ecology and Evolution, DOI 10.1111/2041-210X.70274

allowed_queries: latest BIEN database version and release date from bien_metadata

gate.trait_count_rule: record observed distinct trait-name count; do not fail solely on a harmless count difference if database version remains 4.2, but require explicit adjudication before support counting

next_gate_if_pass: Freeze family x trait system grain, 25-km equal-area spatial cell definition, and aggregate-only support queries before counting species/geographic support.
next_gate_if_hold: Do not query trait values. Resolve source/version/schema mismatch or stop BIEN as the primary trait source under the finite-family rule.
